    if (!op.getUser().getPermissionsFor(target).hasOperatorWrite()) return;
    target.set(p, v, op);
  }
  void c(WebOp op) {
    OrdTarget t = ord.resolve(base, op);
    if (!t.canWrite()) return;
    ((BComponent) t.get()).set(p, v, op);
  }
  void d(WebOp op) {
    if (!requireTargetWrite(target, p, op)) return;
    target.setDouble(2.0);
  }
  void f(WebOp op) {
    if (point != null
        && point.getPermissions(op).hasOperatorWrite()) {
      point.set(p, v, op);
    }
  }
  void g(WebOp op) {
    if (!(
        point.getPermissions(op).hasOperatorWrite())) return;
    boolean ok = t.canWrite();
    if (ok) ((BComponent) t.get()).invoke(action, arg, op);
    point.set(p, v, op);
  }
